text:
Maya (Growth): quick sync  were planning a small, community-focused launch: 3 mini-labs + reference app. goal: easy onboarding + measurable dev wins. need launch post, short benchmark blurb, 3 social variants, and inbound routing plan. whos in for what?
Leo - DevRel: Ill handle the refapp README + tiny example apps. aiming for <80 LOC per lab and a one-line run command. will add a tiny perf script so we can surface numbers in the blog.
Aj Patel: I can draft the benchmark blurb. will keep it relative: p95 latency, tokens/sec, and a "what you save" line (caching/batching). prefer numbers like "~60ms p95 on a single A10G with batching" if eng ok with those ballparks.
Sam W: inbound routing idea: simple form on the blog -> tag leads as mini-lab or enterprise-interest -> drip sequence (3 messages) -> invite to monthly office hours. enterprise flag routes to pd-ops@redwood.
Priya (Growth Ops): Ill set up the form + tags. recommend a hidden field for repo used so we can segment. also add consent checkbox for product emails (GDPR-friendly).
Maya (Growth): for the blog voice: "learn-by-building" and "predictable inference economics". short headline + quick bullets for results. also want 3 social captions: tiny (X), medium (LinkedIn), and long (thread/email snippet).
Leo - DevRel: sample run snippet for the refapp:```bash
# local demo
python demo/run.py --model redwood-small --prompt "Summarize this doc in one line"
```
Maya (Growth): perfect. Aj, make the benchmark blurb 2 short paras plus a 1-line TL;DR for the social snippet. prioritize clarity over precision.
Aj Patel: on it. drafting a TL;DR: "Ship a feature with predictable latency (~60ms p95) and 3-4x cost benefit when using our caching defaults." will add a note: "numbers vary by hardware/workload."
Sam W: routing nit: add a score threshold (e.g., if they request >100 seats or check enterprise) -> create high-touch lead in Salesforce. low-touch -> marketing drip + invite to community Slack channel.
Priya (Growth Ops): well add UTMs for lab downloads so we can tie conversion to the blog. and add an automation: if someone downloads 2+ labs, mark as "active-engager".
Maya (Growth): timeline: rough draft blog + assets by Mon EOD, code samples by Mon noon, form wired Mon EOD, internal review Tue morning, publish Tue afternoon. pref to run a small webinar only if signups > 200 in 48h.
Leo - DevRel: will also add a CONTRIBUTING snippet + issue template labeled "mini-lab-bug" so community feedback funnels via GH issues.
ciara-bot: checklist created: [ ] blog draft (Maya) [ ] benchmark blurb (Aj) [ ] refapp README + examples (Leo) [ ] form + tags + automations (Priya) [ ] drip email copy (Maya/Priya). link: https://drive.redwood/mini-labs/launch-pack
Maya (Growth): little experiment for messaging iteration: well A/B test two headlines on the blog and two TL;DRs on X. track CTR -> downloads -> active-engagers. anyone want to propose alt headlines now?
Aj Patel: alt headline idea: "Mini-labs: Build features that scale inference costs down"
Leo - DevRel: alt: "Ship an LLM feature in <1 hour: three bite-sized labs and a refapp"
Maya (Growth): love both. Ill slot them into the A/B and add a small tracking spreadsheet. thanks team 680
Maya (Growth): final ask: keep social captions dev-forward, avoid buzzwords. simple CTA: "Try the mini-labs" + link.
Priya (Growth Ops): noted. deploying the form to staging now. will ping when live.
Leo - DevRel: pushed sample code to GH draft repo: https://github.com/redwood/mini-labs (private until publish). includes run_demo.sh + microbenchmark.py
Maya (Growth): ok closing loop 4C4 deliverables aligned. well reconvene Tue AM if anything blocks.
